From: Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@brightlinehealth.com>

Cc: security@brightlinehealth.com, procurement@brightlinehealth.com
Date: 2027-05-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: compact evidence bundle for procurement review

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this — Brightline's procurement team needs a compact bundle of security evidence to close our review: the latest SOC 2 report, a SIG/CAIQ compact answers file, and any short certifying notes about token/credential rotation (we run periodic checks). We prefer a single upload to Whistic or OneTrust (vendor portal), but if it's easier you can also stage an S3 link.

Timing: can you provide the bundle by EOD Monday (May 10)? We're on a tight approval window for a Q3 pilot.

Questions from our side:
- Do you have a condensed SIG (not the full 400+ Qs) or a compact spreadsheet?
- Any notes on how you handle API key rotation and KMS integration?
- If you can share the SOC 2 PDF that will speed legal.

Appreciate it — tell me what you need from our side.

Elena Ramirez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Brightline Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: compact evidence bundle for procurement review

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Monday EOD is workable.

Plan: Mina will curate the SOC 2 PDF and a compact SIG spreadsheet; Laura will export a CAIQ excerpt from OneTrust. We'll upload a single zip/manifest to Whistic and also provide an S3 staging link for your security team to pull. I'll also include a short one-page note describing our API token rotation cadence and KMS usage.

Two quick asks for you:
- Confirm whether Whistic access or a OneTrust share link is preferred (we can do both).
- If possible, provide the HubSpot deal id so we can tag the upload (helps our audit trail).

I'll follow up once Mina/Laur a have the bundle ready.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

- onetrust-upload-manifest.csv (map of filenames -> control tags)

Upload plan:
1) Generate the compact SIG spreadsheet and CAIQ export; QA by Laura.
2) Upload to Whistic profile and set visibility to Brightline Health (company share).
3) Stage the same bundle to a signed S3 path for direct download: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/staging/brightline-20270508/ (expiry in 7 days).
4) Post a short manifest with MD5 checksums and a list of included artifacts.

OneTrust / API token note: we'll avoid creating long-lived tokens. I'll include the API token rotation steps for your engineers. Steps are: create short-lived integration token via our OneTrust service account, rotate every 90 days, store in customer-scoped vault entry. I'll attach a stub guide (api-token-rotation-guide.txt).

I'll have the upload and links ready by Monday morning; Jordan, if you want me to include anything extra for legal (delegation letters, subprocessor list) say so.

— Mina
